hints.title: Prefix Mirroring Principle
hints.text: A palindrome of fixed length is uniquely determined by its first half of digits.

hints.title: Half-Length Calculation
hints.text: The first half has length L = (intLength + 1) // 2. The smallest L-digit number is 10^(L - 1).

hints.title: Query Indexing
hints.text: The q-th palindrome prefix is base = 10^(L - 1) + q - 1. If base >= 10^L, such a palindrome does not exist so output -1.

hints.title: Palindrome Reconstruction
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def kthPalindrome(self, queries: list[int], intLength: int) -> list[int]:
        L = (intLength + 1) // 2
        start = 10 ** (L - 1)
        limit = 10 ** L
        ans = []
        for q in queries:
            val = start + q - 1
            if val >= limit:
                ans.append(-1)
            else:
                s = str(val)
                pal = s + (s[-2::-1] if intLength % 2 == 1 else s[::-1])
                ans.append(int(pal))
        return ans
```

complexity.notes: Constructing each palindrome string takes O(L) steps.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating palindromes one by one up to Q TLEs for large query values.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant extra memory beyond output list.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate deduces half-prefix arithmetic bijection directly.
